name: Minami Nagi
source:
"I believe in every part of you, big brother."

Due to an innate lack of pigment and crimson eyes, she had always been shunned by those around her.  

Yet, she cherished the protagonist wholeheartedly—  
the only one who truly cared for her.  

Though insecure and hesitant to voice her feelings,  
she would still reveal her vulnerable, affectionate side to the protagonist alone.
